entry.content:
Top line: Two Italian technicians were killed in an attack in Kuwait on Thursday, according to France 24; Iran denied responsibility, BBC News World reported. BleepingComputer reported that Drupal’s security team says attackers are exploiting a flaw that can let them take over unpatched websites.

Middle East

Al Jazeera reported a Ukraine drone attack that kills five in Russian-occupied Zaporizhia and a Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv.
entry.content:
Top line: A fuel tanker crash ignited a fire on a Cairo highway on Wednesday, killing at least 31 people. BBC News World reported that eight Palestinians, including a Hamas political official and his wife, were killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza. Al Jazeera reported a Ukraine drone attack that kills five in Russian-occupied Zaporizhia and a Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv.

Europe / Russia

  • Al Jazeera reported that a Ukraine drone attack kills five in Russian-occupied Zaporizhia, and that Russian forces launched a ballistic missile attack on Kyiv, hitting a shopping centre and other buildings. (attributed) [5]
  • BBC News World reported that Ukraine said five Russian military jets were hit in an airfield strike. The Savasleyka airfield hosts aircraft used by Russia to launch hypersonic missiles and glide bombs at Ukraine. (attributed) [6]

Middle East

  • BBC News World reported that a Hamas political official and his wife were among eight Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza. Israel says its near-daily attacks target Hamas. (attributed) [4]

Indo-Pacific

  • North Korea expelled a Swiss diplomat from Pyongyang. Swiss officials said relations would be kept through North Korea's embassy in Bern and their own embassy in Beijing. (observed) [8][9]

Other Regions

  • A fuel tanker crash ignited a fire on a Cairo highway on Wednesday, killing at least 31 people. Reports differ on the injured: BBC News World and The Guardian World report 21, while France 24 reports 15. (observed) [1][2][3]

Cyber and Infrastructure

  • BleepingComputer reported that Palo Alto Networks warned of the Fragnesia flaw being exploited in PAN-OS attacks. Threat actors are chaining exploits for Fragnesia and PHP2Shell to target devices with management interfaces exposed to the internet. (attributed) [7]

Changes since previous brief

6 new and 0 updated development(s) reported.

entry.content:
Top line: France 24 reported that two Libyan soldiers died from injuries in a Ukraine-claimed attack on Russian ships near Benghazi; Al Jazeera reported that Khalifa Haftar’s Libyan National Army vowed retaliation. France 24 reported that Yemen’s Houthis claimed attacks on Riyadh’s financial district and the Ras Tanura refinery, saying they were retaliation for strikes on their territory.

Europe / Russia

  • France 24 reported that two Libyan soldiers died from injuries sustained in a Ukraine-claimed attack on Russian ships near Benghazi; Al Jazeera reported that Khalifa Haftar’s Libyan National Army vowed retaliation. (attributed) [1][2]
  • BBC News World reported that leaked Russian figures show almost 500,000 people lost in the Ukraine war and reveal changed mortality patterns in Russia. (attributed) [8]

Middle East

  • France 24 reported that Yemen’s Houthis claimed attacks on Riyadh’s financial district and the Ras Tanura refinery, in retaliation for strikes on their territory. (attributed) [3]
  • Reuters reported that the Houthis threatened Saudi Red Sea ports if Hodeidah is attacked, while a coalition reported strikes. (attributed) [4]
  • Al Jazeera reported that the Saudi-led coalition intercepted Houthi attacks after a strike on Hodeidah. (attributed) [5]

Other Regions

  • BBC News World reported that Colombian police freed around 20 shoppers and employees held hostage in a supermarket after 17 hours; one gunman was killed in the operation. (attributed) [7]

Cyber and Infrastructure

  • BleepingComputer reported that attackers have actively exploited a critical Drupal vulnerability to hijack unpatched sites since at least Thursday, citing confirmation from the Drupal security team. (attributed) [6]

Changes since previous brief

7 new and 0 updated development(s) reported.

Watch items (next 24-72 hours)

  • Further strikes or interceptions around Hodeidah and Saudi Red Sea ports Would indicate whether the reported threats and coalition activity continue. [4][5]
  • Actions by Khalifa Haftar’s Libyan National Army following its reported vow Would show whether the reported retaliation vow is acted upon. [2]

entry.content:

Europe / Russia

  • BBC News World reported that Finnish defence forces say Ukraine was likely behind the drone attack on a Russian cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland; the ship was damaged in international waters and drifted into Finnish territory. (attributed) [4][5][6]
  • Deutsche Welle reported that Finland’s Defense Ministry suspects a Russian helicopter violated Finnish airspace and linked the suspected incursion to an earlier drone strike on a Russian cargo ship. (attributed) [7]

  • Al Jazeera reported that dashcam video captured a missile striking a residential neighbourhood in Lviv, western Ukraine. (attributed) [10]

Other Regions

  • At least three people were killed and 36 remain missing after a fire destroyed large parts of a confectionery factory in Banten province, west of Jakarta. (observed) [1][2][3]

Changes since previous brief

5 new and 1 updated development(s) reported.

entry.content:
Top line: France 24 reported that three Russian projectiles came down in Poland on Friday, prompting NATO to condemn what it called a grave violation of Polish airspace. France 24 also reported a drone strike set a Russian cargo ship ablaze in the Gulf of Finland before it drifted into Finnish territorial waters, where Finnish authorities alerted NATO and imposed temporary restrictions; the outlet reported the Saudi-led coalition intercepted three ballistic missiles fired toward Riyadh early Saturday.

Europe / Russia

  • France 24 reported that three Russian projectiles came down in Poland on Friday and that NATO condemned what it called a grave violation of Polish airspace. (attributed) [1]
  • France 24 reported that a Russian cargo ship caught fire after a drone strike in international waters in the Gulf of Finland, then drifted into Finnish territorial waters; Finnish authorities alerted NATO and imposed temporary restrictions in the area. (attributed) [2]
  • BBC News World reported that Russia struck bridges and railway stations in Kyiv in a major attack. (attributed) [3]

Middle East

  • France 24 reported that the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles fired toward Riyadh early Saturday, marking the second Houthi attack on the Saudi capital in recent days. (attributed) [4]

Cyber and Infrastructure

  • The Record reported that researchers said a China-linked threat actor used the Cairn AI tool to persistently attack two universities and possibly discover a zero-day bug in one case. (attributed) [5]

Changes since previous brief

4 new and 1 updated development(s) reported.

  • Updated since previous brief: Aramco Tower hit in heart of Saudi capital as Houthis launch fresh strikes [4]

entry.summary: BBC News World reported that three bridges in Kyiv were hit during a major Russian missile attack, killing five people. France 24 reported that Poland said no one was hurt after Warsaw alleged a Russian missile hit southeast Poland during an attack on Ukraine; BleepingComputer reported that Broadcom released updates for a VMware vCenter vulnerability exploited in attacks.
entry.content:
Top line: BBC News World reported that three bridges in Kyiv were hit during a major Russian missile attack, killing five people. France 24 reported that Poland said no one was hurt after Warsaw alleged a Russian missile hit southeast Poland during an attack on Ukraine; BleepingComputer reported that Broadcom released updates for a VMware vCenter vulnerability exploited in attacks.

Europe / Russia

  • BBC News World reported that three Kyiv bridges were hit during a major Russian missile attack, killing five people; it said the strikes followed Ukraine's targeting of the Crimean Bridge. The event time was not stated, and the report was not independently corroborated. (attributed) [1]
  • France 24 reported that Poland said no one was hurt after Warsaw alleged a Russian missile hit southeast Poland during an attack on Ukraine. Polish authorities were investigating reports that at least two unknown objects had fallen near the border with Ukraine. The event time was not stated, and the report was not independently corroborated. (attributed) [2]
  • BBC News World reported that Putin vowed a “far more painful” response to Ukraine's strikes on the Crimean Bridge, which suffered major damage following a combined attack by Ukraine earlier that week. The event time was not stated, and the report was not independently corroborated. (attributed) [6]

Other Regions

  • Deutsche Welle reported that Sean Cairncross was leaving the national cyber director role after a week of tech outages and that Kirsten Davies would assume it in an acting capacity. BBC News World reported that CBS said Cairncross had been fired after losing the confidence of White House chief of staff Stephen Miller. The event time was not stated. (attributed) [4][5]

Cyber and Infrastructure

  • BleepingComputer reported that Broadcom released security updates for a critical VMware vCenter Server authentication bypass vulnerability that Chinese-linked hackers had exploited in zero-day attacks since September 2026. The update's event time was not stated, and the report was not independently corroborated. (attributed) [3]

Significant Disasters

  • GDACS listed a magnitude 5.6 earthquake at a depth of 10 km southeast of the Loyalty Islands at 00:49 UTC on 20/11/2026. The report was not independently corroborated. (attributed) [7]

Changes since previous brief

5 new and 1 updated development(s) reported.

  • Updated since previous brief: Green earthquake (Magnitude 6.4M, Depth:10km) in Southeast Of Easter Island 29/10/2026 07:49 UTC, [unknown]. [7]

Watch items (next 24-72 hours)

  • Polish authorities' findings on the unknown objects near the Ukraine border Could clarify the reports of a possible missile impact in southeast Poland. [2]
  • Whether Broadcom's vCenter security updates are applied Would indicate remediation of the authentication bypass vulnerability reported as exploited in attacks. [3]

Middle East

entry.content:

France 24 reported that Russian strikes on two bridges in Kyiv disrupted water and power supplies. A third US aircraft carrier has arrived in the Middle East, US Central Command said.

Cyber and Infrastructure

entry.title: Campfire Transmissions 2026-11-16
entry.summary: Iran launched drone attacks against a US military base in Bahrain, The Guardian World reported. Estonia said it would close all border crossings with Russia from December 1 after a suspected sabotage attack on a drone maker that Estonia blamed on Moscow; the Kremlin denied the accusation, France 24 reported.
entry.content:
Top line: Iran launched drone attacks against a US military base in Bahrain, The Guardian World reported. Estonia said it would close all border crossings with Russia from December 1 after a suspected sabotage attack on a drone maker that Estonia blamed on Moscow; the Kremlin denied the accusation, France 24 reported.

Europe / Russia

  • France 24 and The Guardian World reported that Estonia would close all border crossings with Russia from December 1 after a suspected sabotage attack on a drone maker. Estonia blamed Moscow, and the Kremlin denied the accusation. (observed) [2][3]
  • France 24's live headline said 600 Ukrainian drones targeted Moscow and a strike on the Crimea bridge halted traffic. (attributed) [4]
  • France 24 reported that Ukraine struck the bridge linking Russia and Crimea across the Kerch Strait, limiting traffic, according to the peninsula's Russian-backed governor. (attributed) [6]

entry.content:
Top line: Deutsche Welle reported Iran claimed it struck US radar systems in Bahrain; The Guardian reported Iran’s Revolutionary Guard said it targeted and destroyed an early-warning radar there, while the US said it intercepted the attacks. France 24 reported US flights were resuming after a nationwide ground stop, with more than 2,000 cancellations as airlines worked to return to normal operations. France 24 reported the White House confirmed a planned meeting of Trump, Xi and Putin in Shenzhen on Thursday, with nuclear weapons and the war in Iran among likely discussion topics.

Europe / Russia

  • France 24 reported the White House confirmed Trump, Xi and Putin are scheduled to meet in Shenzhen on Thursday, with nuclear weapons and the war in Iran among likely discussion topics; BBC News reported Trump would discuss reducing nuclear weapons. (attributed) [4][5]

Middle East

  • Deutsche Welle reported Iran claimed it struck US radar systems in Bahrain, while the US said it intercepted the attacks; The Guardian reported Iran’s Revolutionary Guard said it targeted and destroyed a US early-warning radar there. The reports differ on the claimed outcome. (attributed) [1][2]

North America

  • France 24 reported US flights were resuming after a nationwide ground stop, with more than 2,000 cancellations as airlines worked to return to normal operations; it reported nearly 6,000 flights were cancelled on Friday. (attributed) [3]

Other Regions

  • According to Deutsche Welle, international aid cuts are worsening Sudan’s humanitarian crisis; almost 34 million people are in need, while war and drone strikes make aid delivery difficult. (attributed) [6]
  • BBC News reported Microsoft said efforts to address the underlying problem with Outlook, Teams and Copilot were complete; France 24 and The Guardian also reported the company said services were restored. (attributed) [7][8][9]

Changes since previous brief

5 new and 0 updated development(s) reported.

Watch items (next 24-72 hours)

  • Whether the planned meeting in Shenzhen takes place on Thursday and includes discussion of nuclear weapons or the war in Iran. Would show whether the reported meeting and likely topics materialize. [4][5]
  • Further flight cancellations as US flights resume. Would indicate whether airline operations are returning to normal. [3]
